title: Introducing the Model Context Protocol (Anthropic 官方发布公告)
key_points: MCP 于 2024-11-25 由 Anthropic 开源发布，定位为连接 AI 助手与数据所在系统的新标准（a new standard for connecting AI assistants to the systems where data lives）。
设计动机：模型能力虽快速进步，但即使最先进的模型也受限于与数据的隔离，被困在信息孤岛与遗留系统之后（constrained by their isolation from data—trapped behind information silos and legacy systems）。
核心痛点：每个新数据源都需要自己的定制实现，使真正互联的系统难以规模化（Every new data source requires its own custom implementation, making truly connected systems difficult to scale）。
解决方案定位：提供通用、开放的标准，用单一协议取代碎片化集成（a universal, open standard... replacing fragmented integrations with a single protocol）。
发布时包含三部分：MCP 规范与 SDK、Claude Desktop 的本地 MCP server 支持、开源 MCP servers 仓库。
架构一句话描述：开发者可通过 MCP servers 暴露数据，或构建连接这些 servers 的 AI 应用（MCP clients）。
发布时提供 Google Drive、Slack、GitHub、Git、Postgres、Puppeteer 等预构建 MCP servers；早期采用者包括 Block、Apollo，开发工具公司包括 Zed、Replit、Codeium、Sourcegraph。
raw_excerpt: Every new data source requires its own custom implementation, making truly connected systems difficult to scale. MCP addresses this challenge. It provides a universal, open standard for connecting AI systems with data sources, replacing fragmented integrations with a single protocol.

title: Model Context Protocol Specification 2024-11-05 — Introduction
key_points: 权威定义：MCP 是一个开放协议，实现 LLM 应用与外部数据源和工具之间的无缝集成（an open protocol that enables seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources and tools）。
三大能力：与语言模型共享上下文信息；向 AI 系统暴露工具与能力；构建可组合的集成与工作流。
通信基于 JSON-RPC 2.0，三方角色：Hosts（发起连接的 LLM 应用）、Clients（host 应用内的连接器）、Servers（提供上下文与能力的服务）。
明确的设计灵感来源：MCP 受 Language Server Protocol (LSP) 启发——LSP 标准化了跨整个开发工具生态添加语言支持的方式，MCP 以类似方式标准化向 AI 应用生态集成额外上下文与工具。
服务器三类原语：Resources（供用户或 AI 模型使用的上下文与数据）、Prompts（面向用户的模板化消息与工作流）、Tools（供 AI 模型执行的函数）。
客户端提供的特性：Sampling（服务器发起的 agentic 行为与递归 LLM 交互）。
安全原则：工具代表任意代码执行，host 必须在调用任何工具前获得用户明确同意；host 在向 servers 暴露用户数据前必须获得明确同意。
raw_excerpt: MCP takes some inspiration from the Language Server Protocol, which standardizes how to add support for programming languages across a whole ecosystem of development tools. In a similar way, MCP standardizes how to integrate additional context and tools into the ecosystem of AI applications.

title: Model Context Protocol Specification 2024-11-05 — Architecture
key_points: 架构：MCP 采用 client-host-server 架构，每个 host 可运行多个 client 实例；基于 JSON-RPC，是聚焦上下文交换与 sampling 协调的有状态会话协议（stateful session protocol focused on context exchange and sampling coordination）。
Host 职责：创建并管理多个 client 实例、控制 client 连接权限与生命周期、执行安全策略与同意要求、处理用户授权决策、协调 AI/LLM 集成与 sampling、跨 client 聚合上下文。
Client 与 server 为 1:1 关系：每个 client 与特定 server 保持一个隔离的有状态会话，负责协议协商与能力交换、双向路由消息、管理订阅与通知、维护 server 间安全边界。
Server 职责：通过 MCP 原语暴露 resources、tools、prompts；独立运行、职责聚焦；可通过 client 接口请求 sampling；可为本地进程或远程服务。
四条设计原则：(1) servers 应极易构建；(2) servers 应高度可组合；(3) servers 不应能读取整个对话、也不能『看进』其他 server；(4) 功能可在 servers 与 clients 上渐进添加。
消息类型：Requests（双向、含 method 与参数、期待响应）、Responses（成功结果或错误）、Notifications（单向、无需响应），均遵循 JSON-RPC 2.0。
能力协商：初始化时双方显式声明支持的能力——servers 声明 resource subscriptions、tool support、prompt templates；clients 声明 sampling 支持与 notification handling；双方须在整个会话中遵守已声明能力。
raw_excerpt: Servers should not be able to read the whole conversation, nor 'see into' other servers... Full conversation history stays with the host... Each server connection maintains isolation... Cross-server interactions are controlled by the host.

title: MCP Docs — Getting Started/Intro 与 Learn/Architecture（现行官方文档）
key_points: 类比：把 MCP 想象成 AI 应用的 USB-C 端口——正如 USB-C 提供连接电子设备的标准化方式，MCP 提供连接 AI 应用与外部系统的标准化方式。
协议边界声明（关键）：MCP 只关注上下文交换协议，不规定 AI 应用如何使用 LLM 或管理所提供的上下文（MCP focuses solely on the protocol for context exchange—it does not dictate how AI applications use LLMs or manage the provided context）。
MCP 包含两个层：Data layer（基于 JSON-RPC 的 client-server 通信协议，含能力与版本发现，以及 tools、resources、prompts、notifications 等核心原语）与 Transport layer（通信机制与通道，含连接建立、消息分帧与授权）。
传输方式：使用 STDIO 传输的本地 MCP server 通常服务单个 client；使用 Streamable HTTP 传输的远程 MCP server 通常服务多个 client。
参与者定义：MCP Host 是协调管理一个或多个 MCP client 的 AI 应用；MCP Client 维护与 MCP server 的连接并为 host 获取上下文；MCP Server 是向 client 提供上下文的程序，可本地或远程运行。
生态支持：Claude、ChatGPT、Visual Studio Code、Cursor、MCPJam 等客户端支持 MCP。

title: Wikipedia — Model Context Protocol（二手交叉验证）
key_points: MCP 是 Anthropic 于 2024 年 11 月引入的开放标准与开源框架，用于标准化 AI 系统（如 LLM）与外部工具、系统、数据源集成和共享数据的方式。
『N×M』术语出处：在 MCP 之前，开发者常需为每个数据源或工具构建定制连接器，形成 Anthropic 所描述的『N×M』数据集成问题（resulting in what Anthropic described as an 'N×M' data integration problem）。
与既有方案关系：OpenAI 2023 年的 function-calling API 与 ChatGPT 插件框架解决了类似问题，但需要厂商特定的连接器（required vendor-specific connectors）。
与 LSP 关系：MCP 复用了 Language Server Protocol (LSP) 的消息流思想。
协议区分 MCP host、MCP client、MCP server；host 为每个 server 创建专用 client；client 与 host 通常同机运行，servers 可本地或远程。
工作流程：client 向 server 请求工具与资源列表，server 返回各工具能力的自然语言描述与调用格式；该信息交给 LLM；若 LLM 需要某工具，host 指示相应 client 调用；server 执行并返回结果，host 将结果注入 LLM 对话。
2025 年 12 月，Anthropic 将 MCP 捐赠给 Linux Foundation 下的 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。
raw_excerpt: Before MCP, developers often had to build custom connectors for each data source or tool, resulting in what Anthropic described as an 'N×M' data integration problem.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Architecture (client-host-server)
key_points: MCP follows a client-host-server architecture where each host can run multiple client instances; it is built on JSON-RPC and is a stateful session protocol focused on context exchange and sampling coordination.

Host role: creates and manages multiple client instances; controls client connection permissions and lifecycle; enforces security policies and consent requirements; handles user authorization decisions; coordinates AI/LLM integration and sampling; manages context aggregation across clients.

Client role: created by the host, maintains an isolated server connection; establishes one stateful session per server; handles protocol negotiation and capability exchange; routes protocol messages bidirectionally; manages subscriptions and notifications; maintains security boundaries between servers.

Server role: exposes resources, tools and prompts via MCP primitives; operates independently with focused responsibilities; can request sampling through client interfaces; can be local processes or remote services.
Cardinality: a host application creates and manages multiple clients, with each client having a 1:1 relationship with a particular server.

Design principle: servers should not be able to read the whole conversation, nor 'see into' other servers; full conversation history stays with the host and each server connection maintains isolation.

Capability negotiation: clients and servers explicitly declare supported features during initialization; servers declare capabilities like resource subscriptions, tool support and prompt templates; clients declare capabilities like sampling support and notification handling; both parties must respect declared capabilities throughout the session.

Implemented server features must be advertised in the server's capabilities (e.g., emitting resource subscription notifications requires declaring subscription support; tool invocation requires declaring tool capabilities).

Built on JSON-RPC, MCP provides a stateful session protocol focused on context exchange and sampling coordination between clients and servers. ... A host application creates and manages multiple clients, with each client having a 1:1 relationship with a particular server.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Lifecycle (initialization, version & capability negotiation)
key_points: MCP defines three lifecycle phases: Initialization (capability negotiation and protocol version agreement), Operation (normal protocol communication), and Shutdown (graceful termination).

Initialization MUST be the first interaction; the client MUST initiate by sending an `initialize` request containing the protocol version supported, client capabilities, and client implementation information.

The server MUST respond with its own capabilities and information (including optional `instructions`); after successful initialization the client MUST send an `initialized` notification (notifications/initialized) to indicate readiness.

The client SHOULD NOT send requests other than pings before the server has responded to the initialize request; the server SHOULD NOT send requests other than pings and logging before receiving the initialized notification.

Version negotiation: the client MUST send a version it supports (SHOULD be latest); if the server supports it, it MUST respond with the same version, otherwise MUST respond with another version it supports (SHOULD be latest); if the client does not support the server's returned version it SHOULD disconnect.
If using HTTP, the client MUST include the `MCP-Protocol-Version: <protocol-version>` HTTP header on all subsequent requests to the MCP server.
Client capabilities: roots (filesystem roots), sampling (LLM sampling requests), elicitation (server elicitation requests), experimental (non-standard features).

Server capabilities: prompts (prompt templates), resources (readable resources), tools (callable tools), logging (structured log messages), completions (argument autocompletion), experimental (non-standard features).
Capability objects can describe sub-capabilities such as `listChanged` (list change notifications for prompts, resources, and tools) and `subscribe` (subscribing to individual resource changes).

The initialize request example carries protocolVersion '2025-06-18', client capabilities {roots:{listChanged:true}, sampling:{}, elicitation:{}}, and clientInfo {name,title,version}; the server response carries capabilities {logging, prompts:{listChanged}, resources:{subscribe,listChanged}, tools:{listChanged}}, serverInfo, and optional instructions.
raw_excerpt: The initialization phase MUST be the first interaction between client and server. During this phase, the client and server: Establish protocol version compatibility; Exchange and negotiate capabilities; Share implementation details. ... After successful initialization, the client MUST send an initialized notification to indicate it is ready to begin normal operations.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Server Features: Tools
key_points: Tools allow servers to expose callable functions that can be invoked by language models to interact with external systems (querying databases, calling APIs, performing computations); each tool is uniquely identified by a name and includes metadata describing its schema.

Tools are model-controlled: the language model can discover and invoke tools automatically based on its contextual understanding and the user's prompts; the protocol itself does not mandate any specific user interaction model.
Servers that support tools MUST declare the `tools` capability; `listChanged` indicates whether the server will emit notifications when the list of available tools changes.

Protocol methods: `tools/list` (supports pagination via cursor/nextCursor) and `tools/call` (params: name, arguments); notification `notifications/tools/list_changed` is sent when the tool list changes.

Tool definition fields: name (unique identifier), title (optional human-readable display name), description, inputSchema (JSON Schema of expected parameters), outputSchema (optional JSON Schema of expected output), annotations (optional behavior-describing properties).

Tool results may contain structured or unstructured content; unstructured content is returned in the `content` field as multiple content items of different types (text, image, audio, resource links, embedded resources), plus an `isError` boolean.
Security: clients MUST consider tool annotations to be untrusted unless they come from trusted servers; there SHOULD always be a human in the loop with the ability to deny tool invocations.
raw_excerpt: Tools enable models to interact with external systems, such as querying databases, calling APIs, or performing computations. Each tool is uniquely identified by a name and includes metadata describing its schema. ... Tools in MCP are designed to be model-controlled, meaning that the language model can discover and invoke tools automatically based on its contextual understanding and the user's prompts.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Server Features: Resources
key_points: Resources allow servers to share data that provides context to language models, such as files, database schemas, or application-specific information; each resource is uniquely identified by a URI.
Resources are application-driven: host applications determine how to incorporate context based on their needs (e.g., explicit selection via UI, search/filter, or automatic context inclusion).

Servers that support resources MUST declare the `resources` capability, which supports two optional sub-features: `subscribe` (client can subscribe to be notified of changes to individual resources) and `listChanged` (server emits notifications when the list of available resources changes); servers can support neither, either, or both.

Protocol methods: `resources/list` (paginated), `resources/read` (params: uri; returns a `contents` array with uri, mimeType, and text/blob), and `resources/templates/list` (parameterized resources using URI templates, arguments auto-completable via the completion API); notification `notifications/resources/list_changed`.
Resource templates expose parameterized resources using URI templates, e.g. uriTemplate 'file:///{path}'.
raw_excerpt: Resources allow servers to share data that provides context to language models, such as files, database schemas, or application-specific information. Each resource is uniquely identified by a URI. ... Resources in MCP are designed to be application-driven, with host applications determining how to incorporate context based on their needs.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Server Features: Prompts
key_points: Prompts allow servers to expose prompt templates to clients, providing structured messages and instructions for interacting with language models; clients can discover available prompts, retrieve their contents, and provide arguments to customize them.

Prompts are user-controlled: they are exposed from servers to clients with the intention of the user being able to explicitly select them for use (typically triggered through user-initiated commands such as slash commands).

Servers that support prompts MUST declare the `prompts` capability during initialization; `listChanged` indicates whether the server will emit notifications when the list of available prompts changes.

Protocol methods: `prompts/list` (paginated) and `prompts/get` (params: name, arguments; arguments may be auto-completed through the completion API); notification `notifications/prompts/list_changed`.

Prompt definition fields: name (unique identifier), title (optional human-readable display name), description (optional), arguments (optional list of arguments for customization, each with name, description, required).

PromptMessage: role is either 'user' or 'assistant'; content is one of several content types (text, image, etc.); all content types support optional annotations for metadata about audience, priority, and modification times.
raw_excerpt: Prompts allow servers to provide structured messages and instructions for interacting with language models. Clients can discover available prompts, retrieve their contents, and provide arguments to customize them. ... Prompts are designed to be user-controlled, meaning they are exposed from servers to clients with the intention of the user being able to explicitly select them for use.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Client Features: Sampling
key_points: Sampling provides a standardized way for servers to request LLM sampling ('completions' or 'generations') from language models via clients, allowing clients to maintain control over model access, selection, and permissions while enabling servers to leverage AI capabilities with no server API keys necessary.

Sampling allows servers to implement agentic behaviors by enabling LLM calls to occur nested inside other MCP server features; servers can request text, audio, or image-based interactions and optionally include context from MCP servers in their prompts.
Clients that support sampling MUST declare the `sampling` capability during initialization.
Protocol method: `sampling/createMessage` (server -> client); request params include messages, modelPreferences, systemPrompt, maxTokens; response includes role, content, model, and stopReason.
Model selection uses a preference system combining abstract capability priorities with optional model hints: three normalized priority values (0-1) costPriority, speedPriority, intelligencePriority.
Model hints are treated as substrings that can match model names flexibly; multiple hints are evaluated in order of preference; clients MAY map hints to equivalent models.
Sampling messages can contain text, image (base64 data + mimeType), and audio (base64 data + mimeType) content.

For trust and safety, there SHOULD always be a human in the loop with the ability to deny sampling requests; applications SHOULD let users view and edit prompts before sending and review generated responses before delivery.
raw_excerpt: This flow allows clients to maintain control over model access, selection, and permissions while enabling servers to leverage AI capabilities—with no server API keys necessary. ... Sampling in MCP allows servers to implement agentic behaviors, by enabling LLM calls to occur nested inside other MCP server features.

title: MCP Specification 2025-06-18 — Client Features: Roots
key_points: Roots provide a standardized way for clients to expose filesystem 'roots' to servers; roots define the boundaries of where servers can operate within the filesystem, allowing them to understand which directories and files they have access to.
Servers can request the list of roots from supporting clients and receive notifications when that list changes.
Clients that support roots MUST declare the `roots` capability during initialization; `listChanged` indicates whether the client will emit notifications when the list of roots changes.
Protocol method: `roots/list` (server -> client); notification `notifications/roots/list_changed` is sent by clients that support listChanged when roots change.
Root definition fields: uri (unique identifier; MUST be a file:// URI in the current specification) and name (optional human-readable name for display).
Error handling: clients SHOULD return standard JSON-RPC errors, e.g. -32601 (Method not found) when the client does not support roots, and -32603 for internal errors.

Security: clients MUST only expose roots with appropriate permissions, validate all root URIs to prevent path traversal, implement proper access controls, and monitor root accessibility; servers SHOULD respect root boundaries during operations and validate all paths against provided roots.
raw_excerpt: Roots define the boundaries of where servers can operate within the filesystem, allowing them to understand which directories and files they have access to. ... A root definition includes: uri: Unique identifier for the root. This MUST be a file:// URI in the current specification. name: Optional human-readable name for display purposes.

title: Transports - Model Context Protocol (Specification 2025-06-18)
key_points: MCP 使用 JSON-RPC 编码消息，JSON-RPC 消息 MUST 为 UTF-8 编码
协议定义两种标准传输机制：stdio（标准输入/输出）与 Streamable HTTP
客户端 SHOULD 尽可能支持 stdio
客户端与服务器 MAY 以可插拔方式实现自定义传输（custom transports）
stdio 传输中客户端将 MCP server 作为子进程（subprocess）启动
stdio 中 server 从 stdin 读 JSON-RPC 消息、向 stdout 写消息
stdio 消息以换行符分隔（delimited by newlines），且 MUST NOT 含内嵌换行
stdio 中 server MAY 向 stderr 写 UTF-8 字符串用于日志，客户端 MAY 捕获/转发/忽略
stdio 中 server MUST NOT 向 stdout 写任何非合法 MCP 消息；客户端 MUST NOT 向 server stdin 写任何非合法 MCP 消息
Streamable HTTP 取代（replaces）2024-11-05 版本的 HTTP+SSE 传输
Streamable HTTP 中 server 作为独立进程运行，可处理多个客户端连接，使用 HTTP POST 和 GET 请求
Streamable HTTP 中 server 可选使用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 流式传输多条 server 消息
server MUST 提供单一 HTTP endpoint 路径（MCP endpoint）同时支持 POST 与 GET（示例 https://example.com/mcp）
安全要求：server MUST 校验所有入站连接的 Origin 头以防 DNS rebinding 攻击
安全要求：本地运行时 server SHOULD 仅绑定 localhost (127.0.0.1) 而非 0.0.0.0
安全要求：server SHOULD 对所有连接实现认证
客户端每条 JSON-RPC 消息 MUST 为对 MCP endpoint 的新 HTTP POST 请求
客户端 MUST 包含 Accept 头，同时列出 application/json 与 text/event-stream
若输入为 JSON-RPC response/notification：server 接受则 MUST 返回 202 Accepted 且无 body；不接受则返回 HTTP 错误码（如 400 Bad Request）
若输入为 JSON-RPC request：server MUST 返回 Content-Type: text/event-stream（启动 SSE 流）或 Content-Type: application/json（返回单个 JSON 对象）；客户端 MUST 支持两种情况
raw_excerpt: The protocol currently defines two standard transport mechanisms for client-server communication: stdio, communication over standard in and standard out; Streamable HTTP. Clients SHOULD support stdio whenever possible. ... This replaces the HTTP+SSE transport from protocol version 2024-11-05. ... The server MUST provide a single HTTP endpoint path (hereafter referred to as the MCP endpoint) that supports both POST and GET methods. ... Servers MUST validate the Origin header on all incoming connections to prevent DNS rebinding attacks. When running locally, servers SHOULD bind only to localhost (127.0.0.1) rather than all network interfaces (0.0.0.0).

title: Transports - Model Context Protocol (Specification 2024-11-05)
key_points: 2024-11-05 版本定义两种传输：stdio 与 HTTP with Server-Sent Events (SSE)
SSE 传输要求 server 提供两个 endpoint：一个 SSE endpoint（客户端建立连接、接收 server 消息），一个普通 HTTP POST endpoint（客户端发送消息）
客户端连接时 server MUST 发送一个 endpoint event，包含客户端用于发送消息的 URI
后续客户端消息 MUST 以 HTTP POST 发往该 endpoint
server 消息以 SSE message event 发送，内容为 JSON 编码的 event data
该版本 stdio 描述与 2025-06-18 一致：子进程、newline 分隔、stderr 日志
raw_excerpt: The server MUST provide two endpoints: An SSE endpoint, for clients to establish a connection and receive messages from the server; A regular HTTP POST endpoint for clients to send messages to the server. When a client connects, the server MUST send an endpoint event containing a URI for the client to use for sending messages.

title: Authorization - Model Context Protocol (Specification 2025-06-18)
key_points: 授权在传输层提供，仅针对 HTTP-based 传输定义授权流程
授权对 MCP 实现是 OPTIONAL 的
使用 HTTP-based 传输的实现 SHOULD 遵循本规范
使用 STDIO 传输的实现 SHOULD NOT 遵循本规范，而应从环境变量获取凭据
使用替代传输的实现 MUST 遵循其协议既定的安全最佳实践
合规标准（实现其子集）：OAuth 2.1 IETF DRAFT (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13)、RFC8414、RFC7591、RFC9728
角色模型：受保护的 MCP server 充当 OAuth 2.1 resource server
角色模型：MCP client 充当 OAuth 2.1 client，代表 resource owner 发起受保护资源请求
authorization server 负责与用户交互并签发 access token，可托管于 resource server 或独立实体
authorization server MUST 实现 OAuth 2.1，并针对 confidential 与 public client 采取适当安全措施
authorization server 与 MCP client SHOULD 支持 RFC7591 动态客户端注册
MCP server MUST 实现 RFC9728 Protected Resource Metadata；MCP client MUST 用它做 authorization server 发现
authorization server MUST 提供 RFC8414 metadata；MCP client MUST 使用之
MCP server 返回 401 Unauthorized 时 MUST 使用 WWW-Authenticate 头指示 authorization server 位置
raw_excerpt: A protected MCP server acts as an OAuth 2.1 resource server, capable of accepting and responding to protected resource requests using access tokens. An MCP client acts as an OAuth 2.1 client... Implementations using an STDIO transport SHOULD NOT follow this specification, and instead retrieve credentials from the environment.

title: Key Changes — Model Context Protocol (specification 2026-07-28 changelog)
key_points: 该 changelog 列出的是自上一修订版 2025-11-25 以来对 MCP 规范所做的变更。
主要变更 1：从 Streamable HTTP 传输中移除协议级会话（protocol-level sessions）与 Mcp-Session-Id 头；列表端点（tools/list、resources/list、prompts/list）不再随连接变化；需要跨调用状态的服务器改用显式的、由服务器铸造的 handle，作为普通工具参数传递（SEP-2567）。

主要变更 2：使 MCP 无状态化——移除 initialize / notifications/initialized 握手；每个请求在 _meta 中携带协议版本与客户端能力（io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion、io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities）；客户端 SHOULD 在每个请求中标识自身（io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo），服务器 SHOULD 在每个结果的 _meta 中标识自身（io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo）；版本不匹配返回 UnsupportedProtocolVersionError（SEP-2575）。
主要变更 3：新增 server/discover——服务器 MUST 实现该 RPC 以公布其支持的协议版本、能力与身份；客户端 MAY 在任何其他请求之前调用它做前置版本选择，或在 STDIO 上用作向后兼容探测（SEP-2575）。

主要变更 4：用 subscriptions/listen 取代 HTTP GET 端点与 resources/subscribe / resources/unsubscribe——单一长生命周期的 POST-response 流用于已选择加入的服务器到客户端变更通知；客户端按类型选择加入（toolsListChanged、promptsListChanged、resourcesListChanged、resourceSubscriptions）；服务器确认并用 io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId 标记通知；请求作用域的通知（如 notifications/progress、notifications/message）仍走其所属请求的响应流，而非 subscriptions/listen 流（SEP-2575）。
主要变更 5：移除 ping、logging/setLevel 与 notifications/roots/list_changed；日志级别改为按请求通过 _meta 中的 io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel 设置；服务器 MUST NOT 对未包含该字段的请求发出 notifications/message（SEP-2575）。
主要变更 6：将实验性 tasks 移出核心协议，转为官方扩展（io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks）；重新设计的扩展用 tasks/get 轮询与新增的 tasks/update（客户端到服务器输入）取代阻塞式 tasks/result 方法，移除 tasks/list，并允许服务器无需逐请求选择加入即可主动返回任务 handle（SEP-2663）。

主要变更 7：引入 Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR) 模式，取代此前发送服务器发起请求（如 roots/list、sampling/createMessage、elicitation/create）的做法；服务器返回 InputRequiredResult（resultType: "input_required"），其 inputRequests 字段携带处理该请求所需的额外信息请求；客户端在重试原请求时以 inputResponses 提供所请求的信息（SEP-2322）。
主要变更 8：所有结果现在携带必需的 resultType 字段——普通结果为 "complete"，多轮往返请求的中间结果为 "input_required"；客户端 MUST 将省略该字段的早期协议服务器结果视为 "complete"（SEP-2322）。
主要变更 9：从 Streamable HTTP 传输中移除 SSE 流可恢复性与消息重投递（Last-Event-ID 头与 SSE event ID）；响应流中断会丢失在途请求，客户端 MUST 以新请求 ID 重新发起该请求（SEP-2575）。
次要变更：在 ClientCapabilities 与 ServerCapabilities 中新增 extensions 字段，以支持核心协议之外的可选扩展。
次要变更：为 _meta 键（traceparent、tracestate、baggage）记录 OpenTelemetry trace context 传播约定（SEP-414）。

title: Versioning — Model Context Protocol
key_points: MCP 使用 YYYY-MM-DD 格式的字符串版本标识，用于指示最后一次做出向后不兼容变更的日期。
只要变更保持向后兼容，协议版本号就不会递增，以便在保持互操作性的同时做增量改进。
修订版可被标记为三种状态：Draft（进行中的规范，尚不可消费）、Current（当前协议版本，可供使用且可继续接收向后兼容变更）、Final（过去的、完整的规范，不再变更）。
当前协议版本（The current protocol version）为 2026-07-28。
每个请求通过其 _meta 字段中的 io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion 键声明所使用的协议版本，服务器独立接受或拒绝每个请求；在 Streamable HTTP 上，同一值也由 MCP-Protocol-Version 头携带。
若服务器不支持所请求的版本，会以 UnsupportedProtocolVersionError 响应并列出其支持的版本；客户端可用双方都支持的版本重试，或向用户报错。
希望前置选择版本的客户端可调用 server/discover——一个强制性的 RPC，在单次请求中返回服务器支持的协议版本、能力与身份；调用它是可选的。
与实现基于握手的协议修订版（2025-11-25 及更早）的服务器和客户端互操作时，参见 Backward Compatibility 页面。

title: Specification — Model Context Protocol (2026-07-28)
key_points: 该规范定义权威的协议要求，基于 schema.ts 中的 TypeScript schema。
协议使用 JSON-RPC 2.0 消息在 Hosts（发起连接的 LLM 应用）、Clients（宿主应用内的连接器）、Servers（提供上下文与能力的服务）之间建立通信。
Base Protocol 的关键细节被列为：JSON-RPC 消息格式、无状态自包含请求（Stateless, self-contained requests）、按请求的能力协商（Per-request capability negotiation）。
服务器向客户端提供的特性包括 Resources（上下文与数据）、Prompts（模板化消息与工作流）、Tools（供 AI 模型执行的函数）。
客户端可向服务器提供的特性包括 Elicitation（服务器发起的、向用户索取额外信息的请求）。
核心协议之外，MCP 定义可选扩展，扩展始终为 opt-in 且需客户端与服务器双方显式支持，在初始化期间协商；值得注意的扩展包括 Tasks（长时运行操作的异步执行，含轮询、中途输入与持久 handle）、Skills over MCP、MCP Apps（会话内联渲染的交互式 UI 元素）。
规范包含 Security and Trust & Safety 章节，关键原则包括用户同意与控制、数据隐私、工具安全（工具代表任意代码执行，必须谨慎对待）。

Beyond the core protocol, MCP defines optional extensions that add modular, specialized, or experimental functionality. Extensions are always opt-in and require explicit support from both client and server, negotiated during initialization.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) — OpenAI Agents SDK (JavaScript/TypeScript)

title: ETDI: Mitigating Tool Squatting and Rug Pull Attacks in Model Context Protocol (MCP) by using OAuth-Enhanced Tool Definitions and Policy-Based Access Control
key_points: 论文明确指出标准 MCP 规范存在显著安全漏洞，尤其是 Tool Poisoning（工具投毒）与 Rug Pull（拉地毯）攻击。

论文进一步提出为 MCP 扩展细粒度、基于策略的访问控制（policy-based access control），由专用策略引擎依据运行时上下文（而非静态 OAuth scope）动态评估工具能力。
论文将 tool squatting（工具抢注/仿冒）与 rug pull 并列为 MCP 需要缓解的攻击类型。

title: Security Best Practices - Model Context Protocol (官方规范文档 2026-07-28)
key_points: 该文档定位为对 MCP Authorization 规范的补充，识别 MCP 实现特有的安全风险、攻击向量与最佳实践。
目标读者为：实现 MCP 授权流程的开发者、MCP server 运维者、评估 MCP 系统的安全专业人员。
文档要求与 MCP Authorization 规范及 OAuth 2.0 安全最佳实践并读。
文档以「攻击 + 缓解」结构组织，首个详述攻击为 Confused Deputy Problem（混淆代理问题）。
该攻击使恶意客户端可在用户无明确同意的情况下获取授权码，利用的是静态 client ID、动态客户端注册与 consent cookie 三者的组合。
攻击成立需同时满足四个条件：MCP proxy 对第三方授权服务器使用静态 client ID；proxy 允许 MCP client 动态注册（各自获得 client_id）；第三方授权服务器在首次授权后设置 consent cookie；proxy 在转发至第三方授权前未实现按 client 的同意（per-client consent）。
攻击链：用户正常认证后第三方授权服务器在 user agent 上设置 consent cookie → 攻击者发送含恶意 redirect_uri 与新动态注册 client ID 的授权请求链接 → 浏览器仍持有 consent cookie → 授权服务器跳过同意页 → 授权码被重定向到攻击者服务器 → 攻击者换取访问令牌。
